trust.title: Safe automatic updates
trust.sub: Convenient updates should never cost you the safety of your PC.
trust.1.d: Each update is signed with a private key that lives only on the author's machine. The app installs an update only when both the signature and the SHA-256 match, so even a compromised server cannot push malware.
trust.2.d: No accounts, no cookies, no third-party analytics. The server only counts downloads per day and never stores IP addresses or User-Agents.
trust.3.d: Unzip and run, carry it on a USB stick. No installer and no background services.
footer.verify: Every download lists its SHA-256 so you can verify it yourself.
